en.headline: Frieren anime exhibition opens at Mong Kok INCUBASE Arena until early January
en.dek: The authorised show recreates scenes from the first season with five themed areas, life-size props and a Hong Kong-exclusive photo spot, running to 3 January.
body: An official exhibition based on the anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End opened today at INCUBASE Arena on the B2 level of Chong Hing Square in Mong Kok.

Running until 3 January 2027, the show focuses on the first season and features five themed areas that recreate key moments, including statues, a field of blue flowers and character weapons available for photographs.

Organisers said the venue includes a Hong Kong-exclusive scene and a pop-up shop with merchandise. Weekday hours are noon to 10pm with last entry at 9pm; weekends and holidays open from 11am to 10pm with last entry at 9pm.
Single tickets start from HK$128 during the run, with higher-priced options that include extra items.

zh.headline: 《葬送的芙莉蓮特展》香港站今日在旺角創興廣場開幕至明年1月
zh.dek: 官方授權展覽以第一季為主軸，設五大主題展區、1:1武器及香港獨家打卡位，展期至1月3日。
body: 以動畫《葬送的芙莉蓮》第一季為主題的官方特展，今日在旺角創興廣場地庫INCUBASE Arena開幕。
展覽由主辦方Trendic等安排，展期至2027年1月3日，設有五大主題展區，重現經典場面，包括角色雕像、藍色花海及可供拍照的1:1武器。
場內亦有香港站獨家場景及期間限定店。平日開放時間為中午12時至晚上10時，最後入場9時；週末及公眾假期由上午11時至晚上10時，最後入場9時。
展期單人門票由128元起，另有包含周邊的套票選擇。
